facts.fact: Minister Chernor Bah described the Right to Access Information Commission as one of the most-performing national oversight bodies on access to information in Africa.

SLE.note: Only a plan to turn the information commission into an authority; no law or appointment stated.

facts.fact: Minister Bah said Cabinet approved a national Data Protection Policy and a Data Protection and Access to Information Bill will soon go to Parliament.
facts.system: Data Protection and Access to Information Bill

SLE.note: Nothing on criticism, cuts or punishment stated.
Only a validation workshop on the SLBC Act, a broadcasting law, not a digital one.
